name: SwarmMojo
description: Full-fledged local-first AI agent harness combining ROMS (RAG, OKF, MCP, Skills), Swarm Mojo (Aeon specialist reviews, workflow rehearsal, mSGL), PolyHarness (universal configuration & deterministic guardrails), and 10 specialized Buzburg engines (Symdex, Titans, ToolCall, Sieve, Horizon, Fastgate, Compact-KV, Rewind, PathCarry, LocalDocSearch).
guidelines: Always run tests before completing changes (pytest)
Preserve existing comments and docstrings
Write concise commit messages following Conventional Commits
Never commit API keys, tokens, or plain secrets
Keep specialist reviews and decision maker checks bounded and reproducible
Use PathCarry audits before writing or unpacking files on Windows and cross-platform filesystems

commands.test: uv run --directory . --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_engines.py tests/test_swarmmojo.py

rules.name: roms-core
rules.description: Guidelines for ROMS engine, decision maker, and broker components
guidelines: Follow explicit typing and avoid untracked mutations
Keep decision boundaries deterministic and bounded
Use safe path validation for all file access

rules.name: specialized-engines
rules.description: Guidelines for high-speed local agent engines (Symdex, Titans, ToolCall, Sieve, Horizon, Fastgate, Compact-KV, Rewind, PathCarry, LocalDocSearch, Drift, StateFresh, WorkflowProof, Cortex, Triad, MojoMemory)
guidelines: Maintain sub-millisecond execution for in-memory operations and phase vector triage
Enforce cross-platform path safety and reserved-name audit via PathCarry
Keep structured working memory preambles bounded (<800 tokens) via Compact-KV
Maintain native Mojo acceleration in app_mojo/ alongside Python bridges in app/engines/
Enforce angular drift guardrails (warn >=65°, block >=80°) via MojoDrift
Protect workspace mutations from concurrent stale writes via StateFresh OCC
Verify sequential workflows and cache proofs cryptographically via WorkflowProof

rules.name: aeon-swarm
rules.description: Guidelines for Aeon specialist reviews and workflow rehearsal
guidelines: Ensure workflow rehearsals via TriggerTangle remain offline and advisory
Maintain explicit user approvals before mutating workspace state
Keep SGLang and mSGL inference adapters optional and decoupled

rules.name: polyharness-compiler
rules.description: Guidelines for the PolyHarness transpiler engine
guidelines: Maintain zero external runtime dependencies in ESM
Ensure all target formats (Claude, Cursor, DSH, AGENTS) remain synchronized

rules.name: meta-harness
rules.description: Guidelines for SwarmMojo MetaHarness and Coding Agent (Pi Tools + Prime Recursion)
guidelines: Support heterogeneous local and remote models (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, SGLang, mock)
Enforce bounded memory preambles and safe sandbox execution with Rewind checkpoints
Maintain progressive task delegation between coordinators and specialist agents
Use Pi exact unique match editing (edit_file_exact) with strict whitespace matching
Use Prime recursive subagent delegation with strict max_depth limits and context isolation

skills.name: swarm-rehearsal
skills.description: Rehearse automation workflows and causal loops
skills.prompt: Rehearse workflows before execution and verify trigger boundaries

skills.name: polyharness-builder
skills.description: Transpiles agent harness configs to all target formats
skills.prompt: Compile harness.config.json into CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, dsh.config.json, .cursorrules

skills.name: symdex-indexer
skills.description: Index and query symbols and call graphs in microsecond latency
skills.prompt: Use Symdex to find symbol definitions, callers, and callees before editing code

skills.name: titans-memory
skills.description: Test-time neural memory with momentum and surprise gating
skills.prompt: Store verified facts and recall associative knowledge via Titans memory

skills.name: sieve-compactor
skills.description: Prune repetitive build and test output with 95%+ noise reduction
skills.prompt: Filter stdout logs through Sieve to preserve error traces and strip repetitive lines

skills.name: horizon-circuit-breaker
skills.description: Track task DAG and intervene on semantic loops
skills.prompt: Record steps in Horizon task graph to prevent repetitive failed actions

skills.name: rewind-snapshotter
skills.description: Content-addressed workspace snapshotting and microsecond rollback
skills.prompt: Create a checkpoint with Rewind before risky file modifications

skills.name: pi-coding-toolkit
skills.description: Exact unambiguous line slicing, substring editing, and atomic writing
skills.prompt: Use Pi coding tools for precise edits with zero whitespace drift

skills.name: prime-recursion
skills.description: Recursive subagent delegation in single, parallel, and chain modes
skills.prompt: Delegate complex tasks recursively with depth control and pipeline piping

skills.name: drift-guard
skills.description: Real-time angular trajectory tracking and drift guardrails
skills.prompt: Monitor agent actions against anchor task goals and prevent semantic drift

skills.name: meta-orchestrator
skills.description: Orchestrates multi-agent teams across heterogeneous local models
skills.prompt: Coordinate specialist agents, construct task DAGs, and synthesize unified proposals
